scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.test:rules: npm exec --yes --ignore-scripts --package firebase-tools -- firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "vitest run tests/firestore-rules"
scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run export:web && npm exec --yes --ignore-scripts --package firebase-tools -- firebase deploy --only firestore:rules,firestore:indexes,functions,hosting
scripts.deploy:firebase:rules: npm exec --yes --ignore-scripts --package firebase-tools -- firebase deploy --only firestore:rules
scripts.deploy:firebase:indexes: npm exec --yes --ignore-scripts --package firebase-tools -- firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes
scripts.deploy:firebase:functions: npm exec --yes --ignore-scripts --package firebase-tools -- firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy:firebase:hosting: npm run export:web && npm exec --yes --ignore-scripts --package firebase-tools -- firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:firebase:storage: npm exec --yes --ignore-scripts --package firebase-tools -- firebase deploy --only storage
scripts.build:android:production: npm exec --yes --ignore-scripts --package eas-cli -- eas build --platform android --profile production
scripts.build:ios:production: npm exec --yes --ignore-scripts --package eas-cli -- eas build --platform ios --profile production
scripts.build:mobile:production: npm exec --yes --ignore-scripts --package eas-cli -- eas build --platform all --profile production
scripts.submit:android:production: npm exec --yes --ignore-scripts --package eas-cli -- eas submit --platform android --profile production
scripts.submit:ios:production: npm exec --yes --ignore-scripts --package eas-cli -- eas submit --platform ios --profile production
